claims.confidence: high for regulatory timing; medium for willingness to pay
claims.statement: By 2030, Polish property portfolios need repeatable site screening, tendering and evidence workflows because EU solar-installation requirements phase in across new and renovated buildings; the measurable loss is delayed permitting, avoidable engineering work and missed compliance dates.

claims.confidence: medium; pricing is an untested assumption
claims.statement: Property owners and facility managers can plausibly fund orchestration from retrofit, engineering or compliance budgets, but Polish purchasing authority and budget size remain unknown.

commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business through direct portfolio contracts
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Direct outreach to commercial-property managers, energy auditors and referral partners; family installer introductions are legally usable only with consent

fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 55-70% after subcontracted engineering; must be tested

fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Licensed building data, energy-auditor review, travel and contractor time

economics.acquisition_route: Validate one paid multi-site assessment, then standardize data intake and add partner auditors/installers without exclusivity
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: reach 20 portfolios at 35,000 PLN average in year 2, 80 at 45,000 PLN by year 5 and 2.5-4.0m PLN EBITDA by years 7-9; at 4-6x plus reinvested cash, founder value could exceed 5m PLN. Demand, churn and multiples are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 15-25 hours weekly initially; automate screening and subcontract site work before scale
economics.gross_margin_basis: Fees less auditor, engineering, travel, data and support costs
economics.payback: Assumption: pilot setup recovered after 2-3 paid portfolios within 12 months
economics.pricing: Assumption: 15,000-60,000 PLN per portfolio plus 1,000-3,000 PLN per site monitored
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual capital-plan refresh, additional sites and tender cycles

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reusable Polish building-rule mappings, benchmark costs and site-conversion data
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct portfolio contracts plus auditor and installer referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Portfolio solar-readiness assessment and procurement orchestration sold as projects plus monitoring
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Property owner pays when a construction or renovation trigger creates a compliance and capex decision
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Future solar mandates collide with fragmented site data and procurement

founder_fit: Data-science automation fits the founder's skills.
Renewable-installation context offers consent-based learning without relying on confidential assets.
Can begin with one portfolio while employed.

structure.control_point: Embedded portfolio assessment and tender record
structure.critical_dependency: Qualified auditors, installers and customer building data

thesis: Future state: Polish property portfolios routinely convert solar and zero-emission-building rules into capex projects. The missing coordination mechanism is a vendor-neutral workflow joining site data, feasibility, deadlines, tender comparisons and compliance evidence.
title: Solar-Compliance Portfolio Orchestrator
uncertainties: Buyer willingness to separate orchestration from installation
